description: Renovate maintains the npm dependencies and the GitHub Actions pins, replacing the Dependabot version updates this repository used, as in the other hegemony-sh repositories. The groups and the mermaid exception carry over from the former .github/dependabot.yml. Third-party releases wait a week before they are proposed (minimumReleaseAge); security fixes do not.

npm.description: Change a version range only when the new version falls outside it, as Dependabot's increase-if-necessary did; otherwise update the lockfile alone.

packageRules.description: One pull request for every npm minor and patch update.

stylelint and its standard config move together, majors included, as the former Dependabot group did. separateMajorMinor is off here because Renovate would otherwise put a major update on a branch of its own.
vitepress-plugin-mermaid (latest 2.0.17) only supports mermaid 10 or 11 as a peer dependency, so a mermaid 12 bump breaks `npm ci`. Remove this once the plugin accepts mermaid 12.
Action updates are CI changes, grouped for minor and patch.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A known vulnerability is not weekly business: these bypass the schedule and are labelled so they stand out.
